profile_text.body:
Alphabet is a public company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States. It trades under the ticker GOOGL and has SEC CIK number 0001652044. Its website is https://abc.xyz, where the company site text is limited to "Alphabet Investor Relations - Home."

The held facts list no products and no MCP servers for Alphabet. They record 281 law exposure entries in California, though no individual cases are listed. The company is for-profit.
